2_motivation: The stream question (`project.yaml`) is "does the recorded two-stage cross-coefficient factorised closed-form head beat the shipped condition->level law on the honest (completeness-certified) panel?". The object exists and was pre-measured offline in `r2s1_direct-B3` (T3-F24/F25) but never shipped as a scored arm, and its round-2 numbers are void because the panel changed. Round 3 also converts the hypothesis that generated it (M15: "the pattern is a CONDITION-DIMENSION effect ... Caveat: n = 1 high-cond_dim cell in this panel") from untestable to testable **for free**: option-A regeneration moved the IC coefficients into the condition vector, raising cond_dim on pfc 2->18, allen_cahn 3->19, fisher_kpp 2->50 while cahn_hilliard stays at 19 on byte-identical data — n = 4 high vs n = 2 low (ifc_heat 3, ifc_poisson 5). The websearcher's D1 verdict is **`preempted-but-MF-composition-open (cite)`** and its open residue reads, verbatim: *"Only the **composition**: OOF-corrected target-as-input stacking on **reduced-basis coefficients of a parametric PDE field**, where stage-1 targets are themselves regressed from the condition vector, scored on a copy-LF-skill panel in the **no-LF-at-test** regime at N_hf down to 5. [...] **The card must name SST/ERC and state that F25 rediscovered the published train/predict discrepancy.**"*; the D2 verdict is also **`preempted-but-MF-composition-open (cite)`**, residue verbatim: *"the **independent variable and estimator** — both published criteria key on task affinity / heterotopic design geometry, neither on **condition dimension vs fit-row count** [...] **Strongest novelty position available to this batch — and it is a diagnostic claim, not an architecture claim.**"* Accordingly the card claims the **composition** and the **discriminator**, names Spyromitros-Xioufis et al. (arXiv:1211.6581, Stacked Single-Target / Ensemble of Regressor Chains) as owning both the cascade and the OOF-corrected gate, and records F25 as a rediscovery of that paper's train/predict discrepancy rather than a finding.
3_description:
new from-scratch round-3 family `models_r3/r3s1_twostage_crosscoef`; condition-only forward signature; stripped view only; leakage tripwire; no LF array opened at any stage; **no gradient-trained arm** (every arm closed-form).
- **Scored column `test_hf`** — two-stage propagation-aware cross-coefficient head. Stage 1 is the shipped head unchanged (centering `ratio = ||mean_i y_i|| / geomean_i ||y_i||`, tau = 1.0 over {fact, add}; bank = {DC/spatial-mean} u {POD 0-49 of the DC-removed fit-fold residual in the selected centering form}; per direction a 5-fold OOF R^2 from the condition over {affine, quadratic, RBF kernel ridge, k-NN}, best family out of fold; SET = directions clearing tau = 0.1, min 1, max 32). **Stage 2 (new)**: remaining directions regressed on the **out-of-fold stage-1 predicted** SET coefficients over the same map bank, with the stage-2 gate both **selected and fitted** on those OOF predictions (tau2 = 0.1). Empty gate => bitwise no-op.
- **Reference arms**: `ref_head_onestage` (the shipped law; matched folds/bases/seed — paired control *and* reproduction seam), `ref_twostage_true_gate` (F25 negative control, reported as a named rediscovery), `ref_dc_only` (the condition->level law, required by round-3 success criterion 1), floors `ref_zero` / `ref_train_mean` / `ref_nn_condition` (seam-checked to `state/anchors_repaired/floors.json` at 1e-9, RAISING on mismatch), `ref_affine_on_hf_train` (seam-checked on both ifc cells to `launch_anchors.json:ifc_floors_repaired`, reported on the sharp cells).
- **Diagnostic columns (L3-bearing)**: per direction and per cell, OOF R^2 (A) from the condition vs (B) from the SET coefficients, the margin B - A, the stage-2 gate size, and the per-cell 3-seed spread of every scored quantity (handed to `r3s4_audit` for mce re-certification). Instrument: `round2/tools/coefficient_factorisation_audit.py`, adapted on use.
- **Folds**: identical to the shipped head so the control is procedure-matched — disjoint 80/10/10, 5 resamples, LOO when `N_train < 20`; the calibration fold is **asserted unused** (no post-hoc stage in this card) rather than merged, keeping the fit fold at exactly 320 rows so the reproduction seam is meaningful.
- **Build gates**: **G-A** reproduction seam (`ref_head_onestage` per-cell 3-seed mean within 3 % of `launch_anchors.json:cards.r2s1_direct-B3.per_dataset_mean_skill`, panel geomean within 28.2174 +/- 0.3612; RAISE, INFRA-class); **G-B** floor seam checks at 1e-9; **G-C** stripped-view leakage tripwire + guard set at the same tier; **G-D** target-scaler pre-flight (`tools/target_scale_spread_audit.py`) on pfc and cahn_hilliard before any test tensor is touched; **G-E** stage-2 no-op assertion (empty gate => `test_hf` == `ref_head_onestage` to 1e-12, which bounds the panel delta below by 0).

| cell | cond_dim | best frozen floor | shipped law (certified) | expected `test_hf` | provisional mce |

Metric that moves: the 6-cell panel geomean of scored `test_hf` skill and the paired per-cell delta against `ref_head_onestage`. Point estimate **-26 %** vs the anchor 36.3912 and **-5 %** (delta ~1.4) vs the shipped law 28.2174, with a pessimistic floor of **-1.6 %** (delta **0.4479**, computed by propagating the pre-measured cahn_hilliard ratio 11.4148/12.5650 = 0.90846 through the 6-cell geomean) if only cahn_hilliard moves. **Vs the noise floor**: the L1 threshold 0.3612 is **2.00x** the measured panel instrument 0.1806 and 4.84x r2s1-B2's 0.0746, and the predicted delta is **1.24x-4.38x** that threshold. Mechanism prediction: max per-direction margin [OOF R^2 from SET coefficients - OOF R^2 from the condition] **>= 0.30 on >= 3 of 4** high-cond_dim cells and **< 0.30 on both** low-cond_dim cells, against round-2's measured no-op margins +0.0054 / +0.0323 / +0.0430 / -0.0751 (bar = 7.0x the largest). Mandatory floor-arm reading: `test_hf` should beat `ref_nn_condition`, `ref_train_mean` and `ref_zero` on all four sharp cells and is expected to **lose to `ref_affine_on_hf_train` on both ifc cells** (8.2507 / 0.9964 vs 1.5938 / 0.9584) — the card makes **no ifc claim** and states the program.md §2 affine-floor verdict explicitly. Criterion-1 reading: `test_hf` vs `ref_dc_only` reported per cell, adjudicated against `r3s4_audit`'s certified mce.
expected_falsification: H-r3s1-B1 — "the cahn_hilliard cross-coefficient effect is a **condition-dimension mechanism**, not a dataset accident, and shipping it with a propagation-aware gate beats the shipped condition->level closed-form law on the honest panel" — is FALSIFIED if **(L1)** the seed-mean panel geomean of `test_hf` fails to beat the matched `ref_head_onestage` by more than **0.3612** skill units (2 x the certified 3-seed panel spread 0.1806 of `r2s1_direct-B3`; `noise_floor.json` has no panel entry) or the sign of that paired delta is not identical at all three seeds, **or (L2)** on `sharp__cahn_hilliard` — byte-identical data to round 2 (same copy-LF reference 0.041802962686225575, same `nn_condition` nRMSE 0.9690069811741324), where the effect was pre-measured at 12.6601 -> 11.4148 — `test_hf` fails to beat `ref_head_onestage` by more than **1.1603569120520159** skill units (that cell's provisional `min_claimable_effect`), **or (L3)** fewer than 3 of the 4 high-cond_dim cells {pfc 18, allen_cahn 19, cahn_hilliard 19, fisher_kpp 50} reach a maximum per-direction margin [OOF R^2 from the SET coefficients - OOF R^2 from the condition] **>= 0.30** at the 3-seed mean, or either low-cond_dim cell {ifc_heat 3, ifc_poisson 5} reaches it (recorded **unresolved**, not fired, on any cell whose 3-seed spread of that margin exceeds 0.10), **or (L4)** `test_hf` is worse than the best frozen floor on any of the four sharp cells (pfc > 48.0773, allen_cahn > 475.8568, fisher_kpp > 390.7015, cahn_hilliard > 23.1803); the two ifc cells carry no falsification weight (N_hf = 5, anecdote-grade per §12.1; `noise_floor.json` has no `ifc_heat` entry) but are reported against both the frozen floors and `affine_on_hf_train`; every number is `provisional` until the in-round 3-seed confirm and `r3s4_audit`'s mce re-certification land.

debug_notes.diagnosis: Rank deficiency, not a broken bank. basis.pod_basis takes the method-of-snapshots route (eigh of the n x n Gram G = R R'), which squares the condition number, so eigh resolves w_j only to an ABSOLUTE accuracy ~ eps*w_max and s_j = sqrt(w_j) is trustworthy only while s_j is comfortably ABOVE sqrt(eps)*s_max. The vendored rank cut keeps every mode with s > sqrt(eps)*s_max — the boundary itself, zero safety margin. heat_local is a smooth guard field whose DC-removed residual spectrum crosses s/s_max = 1e-5 at mode ~19, so modes 19..33 were numerically undetermined and their reconstructed rows V[:,j]/s_j @ R were neither unit-norm nor mutually orthogonal. Reproduced and instrumented on the login node: scratchpad/diagnose_attempt_1.py (spectrum, per-mode row norms, threshold sweep — cut 1e-8 -> 8.4e-01, 1e-7 -> 3.7e-04, 1e-6 -> 3.4e-07) and scratchpad/diagnose_attempt_1b.py (blast radius: all 5 scored panel cells and the guards fluid/sharp__sod_1d sit at max|DD'-I| <= 6.1e-14 / 3.7e-10, i.e. nowhere near the boundary; only heat_local is affected). Dataset-general defect, surfaced by a dataset-specific spectrum — NOT special-cased on heat_local.
debug_notes.fix: basis.py only ([R3-DEBUG-1]). Added `orthonormal_prefix_rank(D, tol)`, which returns the longest leading block of D satisfying the SAME 1e-8 orthonormality tolerance (|DD'-I|[:k,:k].max() is nondecreasing in k, so one searchsorted). DirectionBank now truncates to that rank BEFORE asserting; the tolerance is unchanged and the assertion still raises, with the identical message, when not even the DC direction plus one POD mode survive (unit-tested). WindowBasis gets the same truncation (same defect, it simply never asserted, so undetermined modes were reported silently); it stays non-raising as it feeds diagnostics only in this card.
